messages:
anya: Heads-up — I kicked off a 5% pilot for model v2.1-int4 on /chat-route a few hours ago. Quick smoke looks fine but the hallucination slice we track (legal-qa) jumped from 0.9% -> 3.4% in the last 30m. :eyes:
kevin: ack. Can you paste the slice query and the metric window?
anya: slice query: `slice:labels.contains(\"legal-qa\") && prompt_len > 120`. Window used: 30m rolling; comparison baseline was v2.0-quant on the same traffic.
brad: do we have A/B buckets properly balanced? small sample sizes can cause spikes.
anya: buckets are 50/50 weighted for the split, but the legal-qa traffic is sparse. absolute samples: v2.0=82, v2.1=19 in the last 30m. low N.
sophia: that N is concerning. We should avoid reacting to percent deltas on tiny counts. Can we switch to a hierarchical gate: require >= 50 samples AND delta >= 1.5x before triggering rollback?
kevin: +1 to hysteresis. Also add a minimum absolute delta (e.g., +20 failed prompts) to avoid flip-flop.
anya: makes sense. Current canary config I used: ```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 0.05
  window_minutes: 30
  rollback_thresholds:
    hallucination_rate_ratio: 2.0   # if v2.1 >= 2x baseline
    min_absolute_increase: 10
    min_samples: 50
```
brad: suggest increasing window to 2h for low-volume slices so sample size grows. We can keep 30m for infra SLAs but evaluate quality on 2h.
sophia: agreed. Also we should shadow more legal-qa for staging to get better priors before promotion.
anya: I ran a quick offline eval vs our evalset; v2.1-int4 had slightly worse factual recall but same fluency. Sending logs to the thread.
release-bot: deploy 2812345678 -> pilot started (5% traffic) by anya. canary config: rollback on ratio>=2.0 OR abs_inc>=10 AND min_samples>=50.
kevin: let's do this action plan: 1) increase eval window for slice metrics to 2h, 2) add min_samples/hysteresis to canary gating, 3) shadow additional legal-qa traffic in staging for 24h, 4) hold promotion until we get >=200 samples or delta stable <1.4x for 6h.
sophia: I'll update the canary config in prod and create a small smoke-runbook snippet for on-call.
anya: thanks — I'll pause the rollout if the 2h window still shows a >1.6x increase after the hysteresis rules land.
brad: one more thing — include a quick token-length stratified breakdown in the canary dashboard so we can spot length-dependent regressions. small change but saved us before.
anya: good call. Will add a chart request.
kevin: :thumbsup: keep updates here.
